scope: All game monster definitions, equipment definitions and skills. Existence is not visual approval.

monsters.name: Mosskin
monsters.brief: A round four-legged seed with a mossy shell and two twig antennae; friendly face; earth-green palette.

legacyReview.name: Mosskin
legacyReview.findings: One leafy stalk rather than two twig antennae; only two feet clearly visible. Four-legged seed anatomy needs a new reference.

monsters.name: Sporeling
monsters.brief: A waddling mushroom with a speckled cream-and-rust cap, stubby root feet, puffs of glowing spores.

legacyReview.name: Sporeling
legacyReview.findings: Bright red cap and boot-like feet rather than cream/rust cap and stubby root feet. Revise palette and foot anatomy.

monsters.name: Ambermite
monsters.brief: A beetle-sized six-legged mite under a translucent amber shell with a glowing core; honey-orange.

legacyReview.name: Ambermite
legacyReview.findings: Opaque crystal-armored shell, no visible glowing internal core; six legs not clearly readable. Needs translucent amber shell.

monsters.name: Lunari
monsters.brief: A sugar-glider-like beast with leaf-shaped ears and a banded tail, membrane glide flaps; moonlit silver-green.

legacyReview.name: Lunari
legacyReview.findings: Blue/pink fox-like silhouette with oversized ears; no readable gliding membrane or banded tail, wrong silver-green palette.

monsters.name: Craglet
monsters.brief: A squat lizard covered in slate plates, quartz flecks along the spine, a gear glinting in its belly seam.

monsters.name: Thornback
monsters.brief: A stocky boar with a back of woody thorns and bark-like hide; mossy tusks.

monsters.name: Dustwing
monsters.brief: A large moth with sandy, powder-dusted wings and brass-coloured eyespots; trailing dust motes.

monsters.name: Brookfin
monsters.brief: A fat fish on stubby fin-legs, glass-clear fins showing faint aether veins; blue-green.

monsters.name: Reedstalker
monsters.brief: A lanky stalk-creature woven from reeds, a seed-pod head that opens to spit darts; marsh green and brown.

legacyReview.name: Reedstalker
legacyReview.findings: Bird anatomy contradicts woven reed stalk-creature with opening seed-pod head.

monsters.name: Rotroot
monsters.brief: A knot of rotting roots with a glowing sap core, crawling on root-legs; dark wood, sickly teal glow.

legacyReview.name: Rotroot
legacyReview.findings: Upright red-accented tree creature lacks sickly teal sap core and low crawling root-knot anatomy.

monsters.name: Barkwarden
monsters.brief: A man-high wooden guardian with copper-jointed limbs, a cracked lens eye and moss in the seams.

legacyReview.name: Barkwarden
legacyReview.findings: Organic tree guardian lacks copper joints and single cracked lens eye; leafy seams instead of moss.

monsters.name: Graftling
monsters.brief: A knee-high bundle of living twigs on three folding brass hinge-legs, a jade sap bead glowing at the joint; leaf tufts for a head; bark brown, brass, jade.

monsters.name: Sapdrone
monsters.brief: A fist-sized brass beetle-drone with four glassy wings and a long needle proboscis, its belly tank sloshing with glowing jade sap.

monsters.name: Vinecrawler
monsters.brief: A spider-shaped brass gear-frame wrapped and pulled by thick green vines, leaves sprouting from the gear teeth, a cracked jade lens at the core.

monsters.name: Root Sentinel
monsters.brief: A three-metre humanoid guard of brass and stone, completely laced with thick roots, a lantern-like jade eye under a hood of bark.

monsters.name: Sandcoil
monsters.brief: A thick, short serpent coiled like a spring, scales the colour and grain of saffron sand, ember-orange belly, heat shimmer above it.

monsters.name: Glass Scarab
monsters.brief: A dog-sized scarab whose shell is clear amber glass with a glowing ember core showing through, legs of dark chitin.

monsters.name: Dune Sentry
monsters.brief: A blocky humanoid of carved sandstone with brass bands at the joints, a slit visor glowing orange, sand pouring from its cracks.

monsters.name: Sun Warden
monsters.brief: A tall bronze guardian with a halo-ring of sun mirrors on its back, a faceless polished face, a long spear-gnomon.

monsters.name: Tidehopper
monsters.brief: A frog-sized blue-grey hopper with oversized hind legs, a shell-plate back and bulbous wet eyes; barnacle specks; sea-glass blue.

monsters.name: Coral Claw
monsters.brief: A crab the size of a dog, its shell overgrown with pink and orange coral branches, one claw much larger than the other; wet teal legs.

monsters.name: Brine Automaton
monsters.brief: A barrel-chested copper automaton with piston arms, brine-crusted gauges for eyes and a tank on its back hissing steam; verdigris green and brass.

monsters.name: Relay Guardian
monsters.brief: A tall diving-suit construct with a dish-shaped sonar head, ribbed hoses and lead boots; dark bronze with pulsing cyan rings.

monsters.name: Frost Mite
monsters.brief: A palm-sized mite whose shell is a cluster of clear ice crystals, six thin blue legs, a faint glow inside; frost-white and pale cyan.

monsters.name: Prism Wisp
monsters.brief: A glowing orb inside an open lattice of hexagonal crystal, casting rainbow beams; white core, prismatic edges.

monsters.name: Icegear
monsters.brief: A spider-like walker with a body of stacked frozen gears and eight jointed brass legs, icicles hanging from the cogs; steel blue and brass.

monsters.name: Archive Keeper
monsters.brief: A tall slender construct in faceted crystal armour, a glowing data-slate for a face, long fingers made for handling cores; ice-blue and silver.

monsters.name: Ashcrawler
monsters.brief: A dog-sized segmented crawler with a grey ash shell, ember light glowing between the plates, soot-black legs; slow and placid.

monsters.name: Cinder Imp
monsters.brief: A knee-high charcoal imp with a cracked ember belly, flame wisps for horns, long ash-grey fingers; leaves glowing footprints.

monsters.name: Smelt Hound
monsters.brief: A lean hound of riveted iron plates over a molten core, glowing slag dripping from the jaw, bellows-ribs that pump sparks when it runs.

monsters.name: Furnace Knight
monsters.brief: A tall armoured automaton whose chest is an open furnace door, riveted iron plate, a long blade glowing at the edge, smoke from the helm vents.

monsters.name: Null Wisp
monsters.brief: A floating smudge of violet-black light with a hollow white core, trailing wisps that dim everything they pass; no face.

monsters.name: Shade Carrier
monsters.brief: A boxy six-wheeled freight hauler with a smashed cab full of moving shadow, violet headlamps, cargo doors that open like a jaw.

monsters.name: Lattice Drone
monsters.brief: A floating hexagonal frame of dark metal around a violet lattice core, six thin vanes, a lens that tracks before it fires.

monsters.name: Meridian Executor
monsters.brief: A gaunt four-armed automaton in black ceramic, each arm ending in a long violet blade, a mask with a single vertical slit of light.

monsters.name: Hollowroot Warden
monsters.brief: A hulking root-and-copper colossus around a pulsing aetherite heart; pipes for arms, roots for legs.

monsters.name: Mossback Newt
monsters.brief: A plump newt with a carpet of green moss on its back, a pale belly and round jade eyes; small water droplets glinting on the moss.

monsters.name: Jadewing Moth
monsters.brief: A moth the size of a hawk with translucent jade wings veined like circuitry, glowing eyespots and trailing luminous dust.

monsters.name: Barkhound
monsters.brief: A lean wolf with overlapping bark plates on its back and shoulders, moss on its tail, jade-green eyes; heavy jaws with wooden fangs.

monsters.name: Pruning Tender
monsters.brief: A barrel-bodied brass gardener on three spindly legs with shear-arms and a sap nozzle, a glass tank of jade sap on its back, moss on the lid.

monsters.name: Thistlehare
monsters.brief: A long-eared hare whose fur is a mass of purple-green thistle burrs, a white cotton tail, huge dark eyes; mid-leap pose.

monsters.name: Antlered Engine
monsters.brief: A huge stag of brass ribs and living wood, antlers made of coiled copper and branches hung with moss, a furnace-glow of jade in its chest.

monsters.name: Sporebloat
monsters.brief: A floating puffball the size of a barrel, dark violet with glowing jade spore-vents, short root tendrils hanging below.

monsters.name: Spore Matron
monsters.brief: A tall mushroom with a wide frilled cap, a stalk like a robed figure, jade spore-lanterns hanging under the cap.

monsters.name: Heartwood Pistonguard
monsters.brief: A squat brass guardian with pistons for arms, its body cased in polished heartwood, steam and spores venting from its back.

monsters.name: Heartwood Regent
monsters.brief: A towering figure of living wood grown round a brass pump-heart, a crown of branches, roots for legs, jade light pulsing through its veins with each pump stroke.

monsters.name: Ochre Jackal
monsters.brief: A rangy jackal with ochre fur, huge ears, a dark stripe down the spine and a brass tag from a long-gone caravan on its collar.

monsters.name: Brass Kite
monsters.brief: A diamond-shaped kite of brass foil and cloth on a gear-driven frame, a single focusing lens in its nose, ribbon tails streaming.

monsters.name: Glasstail Basilisk
monsters.brief: A low, heavy basilisk with a tail ending in a club of glowing glass, ridged sandy scales, a frilled crest that flares orange.

monsters.name: Gnomon Acolyte
monsters.brief: A slim brass automaton in sun-bleached robes, a gnomon-shaped crest on its head, mirror-plate hands that catch the light.

monsters.name: Canal Strider
monsters.brief: A water-strider the size of a pony, stilt legs tipped with silver pads, a slim teal body and silt-pearl eyes.

monsters.name: Dust Revenant
monsters.brief: A floating figure in sand-coloured burial wraps trailing dust, an empty hood lit by a dim surveyor's lamp held in a bony hand.

monsters.name: Sand-buried Colossus
monsters.brief: A giant sandstone-and-brass figure buried to the waist, one arm free and dragging, a cracked sun-disc face glowing orange.

monsters.name: Prism Lens-drone
monsters.brief: A floating ring of brass holding a large prism, three small fins, a beam of orange light idling from its centre.

monsters.name: Vault Mirrorguard
monsters.brief: A knight-shaped construct plated in polished mirror bronze, a round shield that is a heliostat mirror, a visor like a lens.

monsters.name: Heliostat Sovereign
monsters.brief: A colossal throne-machine of brass rings and mirrors around a burning sun-core, arms of articulated mirror panels, a crown of lenses.

monsters.name: Gullwing Skimmer
monsters.brief: A long-winged gull with brass-tinted primaries, a hooked orange beak and a crest of storm-grey feathers; mid-dive pose.

monsters.name: Polyp Spitter
monsters.brief: A squat lump of polyps on stubby root-legs, a ring of open tube mouths on top glowing magenta; pink-violet with white tips.

monsters.name: Kelp Tender
monsters.brief: A tall swaying figure of braided kelp with a bulb head glowing soft green, frond arms trailing; small oysters clinging to its stalk.

monsters.name: Hullborer
monsters.brief: A pale segmented worm with a drill-bit shell at its head, wood shavings stuck to its slime; bone-white with rust-red rasp.

monsters.name: Pearl Skate
monsters.brief: A wide diamond-shaped skate with a pearlescent back and a whip tail, skimming on its wing tips; sand-cream with nacre sheen.

monsters.name: Thunderhull Turtle
monsters.brief: A huge turtle whose shell is fused with riveted copper hull plates and a broken porthole; storm-grey skin, barnacles, glowing amber eyes.

monsters.name: Squall Ray
monsters.brief: A manta ray with wing edges crackling blue, a long stinger tail with a copper tip; indigo back, white belly, floating above the ground.

monsters.name: Pressure Drone
monsters.brief: A football-sized brass sphere with three propeller fins and a single red lamp eye, valves venting bubbles; pitted copper and red.

monsters.name: Gloom Medusa
monsters.brief: A translucent violet bell trailing long glowing tendrils, an aether-blue nucleus pulsing inside; dark halo.

monsters.name: Drowned Signalmind
monsters.brief: A colossal brass-and-coral head on cable tentacles, a ring of sonar dishes for a crown, one great cracked lens eye glowing cyan; bubbles and sparks.

monsters.name: Rimehare
monsters.brief: A big white hare with frost-tipped ears and long whiskers rimed with ice, hind legs built for bounding; snow-white, silver-blue shadows.

monsters.name: Glassback Ram
monsters.brief: A shaggy grey ram with curled horns of translucent blue glass and a back of glassy plates; breath steaming.

monsters.name: Frostcoil Serpent
monsters.brief: A long pale-blue serpent with frost-ridged scales and a hood of thin ice fins, glowing coolant-cyan veins along its belly.

monsters.name: Glacier Juggernaut
monsters.brief: A tracked mech twice a man's height with a huge wedge plough blade, a furnace glowing in its chest and frost-crusted armour; rust-red and steel.

monsters.name: Mirrorshade
monsters.brief: A humanoid silhouette of dark mirror glass, reflecting its surroundings warped, edges smoking into shadow; one bright eye-glint.

monsters.name: Hoarfrost Behemoth
monsters.brief: A mammoth-sized beast with a hump of frost-matted wool, four curling tusks and icicles in its fur; white and slate grey.

monsters.name: Cryo Sentry
monsters.brief: A tripod construct with a long frost lance for a head, a cryo cell glowing in its chest, frost venting from its joints; white enamel and cyan.

monsters.name: Archive Specter
monsters.brief: A flickering translucent figure made of scrolling glyph-light, trailing like smoke, face a blank of static; violet and cold white.

monsters.name: Cryo Lancer
monsters.brief: A slim armoured construct with a long rifle-like lance arm, a prism focus at its tip, frosted visor; white and pale blue.

monsters.name: Cryocore Curator
monsters.brief: A towering construct of crystal shelving and brass arms around a glowing blue cryocore, data-slates orbiting it like moons, a frost crown.

monsters.name: Slagback Toad
monsters.brief: A boulder-sized toad with a cracked black slag shell on its back, orange heat in the cracks, wide throat sac glowing like a bellows.

monsters.name: Crucible Tender
monsters.brief: A four-legged brass spider-frame with a welding arc on one arm and a slag scoop on the other; blue-white arc light, soot-stained lens.

monsters.name: Vent Skink
monsters.brief: A slim lizard with glossy black basalt scales, a glowing orange throat and tail tip, heat shimmer over its back.

monsters.name: Magma Spitter
monsters.brief: A thick segmented worm half out of a fissure, a crusted shell collar and a tube mouth dripping magma; dull red with yellow-hot gullet.

monsters.name: Rivet Scrapling
monsters.brief: A fist-sized rattling bundle of rivets, bolts and a single glowing gear-eye on wire legs; moves in jittering hops.

monsters.name: Slagforged Brute
monsters.brief: A hulking ogre-shape of rough black slag with mould seams down its sides, a molten core showing through cracks, iron bands still on its fists.

monsters.name: Pour Wraith
monsters.brief: A dripping humanoid of white-hot liquid metal with no face, trailing a cooling grey skin that cracks and re-melts; a mould seam down its middle.

monsters.name: Zero Stoker
monsters.brief: A broad-shouldered iron automaton with a shovel for one arm and a coal hopper on its back, firebox glow behind a grille face.

monsters.name: Kiln Prime
monsters.brief: A colossal kiln-shaped automaton rising from the core floor, crucible arms that pour molten metal, a white-hot Aetherite heart behind a lattice grille.

monsters.name: Gutter Lurk
monsters.brief: A hairless grey cat-sized scavenger with long fingers, huge reflective eyes and a ridge of violet-lit bristles along the spine.

monsters.name: Nullbloom
monsters.brief: A waist-high flower with petals of matte black glass, a violet light-drinking eye at the centre, roots that leave grey patches where they walk.

monsters.name: Coupler Mite
monsters.brief: A beetle-sized steel mite shaped like a rail coupler, pincer jaws, a single violet status light blinking on its back.

monsters.name: Riftling
monsters.brief: A dog-shaped hole in the world: a black silhouette with violet edges and white pinpoint eyes, flickering at the outline.

monsters.name: Sparkwing
monsters.brief: A crow-sized bird with feathers like copper foil, sparks crackling between the wingtips, violet arcs jumping when it lands.

monsters.name: Array Sentinel
monsters.brief: A tall, faceless sentinel in layered dark plate, a halberd of lattice light, a violet ring rotating behind its head.

monsters.name: Glyph Swarm
monsters.brief: A cloud of glowing violet glyphs that hangs together in the shape of a sigil, spinning when it attacks.

monsters.name: Lattice Weaver
monsters.brief: A long-legged spider of dark brass with a violet spinneret, drawing lines of light between its legs as it moves.

monsters.name: Lattice Sovereign
monsters.brief: A vast crowned lattice of violet light suspended over the chamber floor, a dark crystalline core inside, sentinel-like arms unfolding from the grid.
